name: Pandora Max Series Vol.4 Catch! ~Kimochi Sensation~
original_name: パンドラMAXシリーズVOL.4 Catch! 〜気持ちセンセーション〜
source:
Catch! Kimochi Sensation (Pandora Max Series vol.4) is an adventure game in which the player controls a young student that is busy trying to find a good girl to date until one day he encounters a young girl that comes from 100 years ago. So he will have to deal with her and the other girls from his school and the story will get stranger as the player advance in it.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPS-02712.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
抓住！Kimochi Sensation (Pandora Max Series vol.4) 是一款冒险游戏，玩家控制一名年轻学生，忙于寻找一位好女孩约会，直到有一天他遇到了一位来自100年前的年轻女孩。因此，他将不得不与她和学校的其他女孩打交道，随着玩家的进展，故事会变得更加奇怪。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPS-02712.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
